units.title: Problem Set 2
examples: de Broglie wavelength formulas (non-relativistic and relativistic electrons)
Bohr radius, Compton wavelength and classical electron radius: ratios
plane waves for matter particles: which complex form works

units.title: Problem Set 5
examples: Gaussian wavefunction: uncertainties and their product
particle in a box exercises: energies, expectation values, time evolution
step potential on the infinite line: stationary states and reflection
wall plus half of a finite well: bound-state condition

units.title: Final exam (2015)
examples: virial theorem for 1-D potentials from ⟨[H, Ω]⟩ = 0
hydrogen state with ℓ = m = n − 1: wavefunction, most probable radius, angular localization
scattering phase shift: incoming and outgoing wave packets, time delay
Mach–Zehnder interferometer with beam splitters: bomb-detection probabilities
infinite square well with an extra circular dimension: energy levels and degeneracies
transmission through two delta-function barriers: resonance condition
